purpose: Describe a sustained change beginning with a particular event.
keywords: Vて + からというもの
Ever since I got a dog, I have walked every morning.
Ever since moving, I have been sleeping well.
Ever since reading that book, I have enjoyed watching the stars.
formation: Vて + からというもの
restrictions: The later state continues or recurs from that turning point.
mistake: Use a sustained consequence, not an unrelated one-time event.

segments.role: Describe a sustained change beginning with a particular event. Vて + からというもの
